steps.en: The officer opens the full details of a single record
steps.id: Officer membuka detail lengkap satu record
steps.why_en: There is no detail screen for a warrant record.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar detail untuk record warrant.

steps.en: Details show the work order number and the warrant type
steps.id: Detail menampilkan nomor work order dan jenis warrant
steps.why_en: No work order number anywhere; warrant type is never shown.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada nomor work order; jenis warrant tidak pernah ditampilkan.

steps.en: Details show the name, vehicle number and warrant number
steps.id: Detail menampilkan nama, nomor kendaraan, dan nomor warrant
steps.why_en: Only a per-notice screen shows warrant and offender ID, and it is switched off.
steps.why_id: Hanya layar per notice yang menampilkan warrant dan ID offender, dan itu dimatikan.

steps.en: Details show the address visited and the added and updated dates
steps.id: Detail menampilkan alamat yang dikunjungi serta tanggal ditambah dan diubah
steps.why_en: No visited address in the code; the dates exist only as a type outline.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada alamat kunjungan di code; tanggal hanya kerangka type.
